_about: THE FIFTY, TRANSLATED (COMBAT [perks translated], rule 48, Paolo 9/29: 'the perks need to be translated'): every Battle Brothers perk one for one, its mechanic and its numbers kept exactly (they live in perks.json beside the wiki's words), with our draft name and a one-line skin. Names are attempts (draft:true, rule: words get an attempt, decisions wait); WORDS owns the final voice. THE GAP: the frozen fight's tree (PLATE CARRIER, SECOND SKIN, WALK IT OFF, THEY KNOW YOU, STEADY EYE, QUICK STUDY, LONG WIND, CLOSER, OPENING MOVE: 9 built of the 23 it described) maps to almost none of these; old_tree names the nearest one where there is one, and the frozen tree is not carried over.
